vo: This deer only came for a drink.
cap: It only came for a drink

label: 10 minutes earlier
vo: Ten minutes earlier. Look closer. That pile of weeds... has teeth.
It's the dry season. The water is shrinking, and every animal for miles has to drink right here.
The mugger croc doesn't chase. It waits, with only its eyes and nostrils above the surface.
Its jaws are packed with tiny sensors that feel the faintest ripple.

label: It gets worse
vo: Mugger crocs have even been seen balancing sticks on their snouts... to lure birds looking for nesting material.
So when the herd comes back to drink... it's already waiting.
